purpose: Correctness and independent simplification review; no performance samples
retained_source_operations: Each pi precision independently constructs its scale and runs all three recurrences. Every division/root boundary and simultaneous-state dependency matches the original Scheme. Chudnovsky retains all variable cubes, leaf products/divisions, recursive split trees, integer square roots and final quotients.

fixed_constant_correction.source_cube_setup: Scheme computes C^3 at top level before timing; Rust now evaluates the u64 constant at compile time.
fixed_constant_correction.static_scope: Inspection of the emitted Wasm, not dynamic V8 call counts or a performance measurement.

representation: Rust stores result rows inline in vectors and owns bigint linear-memory buffers. Scheme returns lists and uses tracing collection. A u64 scalar multiplication may select a different bigint routine. Old result remains alive until the next complete result is ready.
simplify_review: Fresh code-free behavioral explanation and debate; fixed setup corrected, complete recurrence functions kept together because old-state reads and truncation points explain one operation. No forwarding helpers or alternate mathematical algorithm.
